title: Five transients appearing and vanishing on 27 July 1952

tellings.quote: One is five objects on a narrow band. And it's from the 27th of July 1952.

plain: On a photograph of the night sky taken on 27 July 1952, five points of light appear in a narrow line and are gone in other exposures, says the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel. She found them on the glass photographic plates of the Palomar Observatory Sky Survey, an old survey of the sky, and calls them "transients", short-lived flashes. To her, such lines could point to unexplained objects near Earth.
